result.summary: The page is largely visually coherent. Excluding intentional horizontal-carousel clipping and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport, one minor layout inconsistency stands out in the 'Fastest near you' row.

issues.description: The delivery-time badge on the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is horizontally centered over the image, while the badges on the sibling cards (e.g. 'Green Bowl Poké') are anchored to the bottom-left of the image. The inconsistent placement looks unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Anchor all time badges to the same position (bottom-left) within each restaurant card so the row is visually consistent.
